run_ensemble_evaluation: run the ensemble evaluation script to evaluate model predictions across multiple datasets and clusters
evaluate_dataset_metric: evaluate a dataset using mean per class accuracy, top-k accuracy, or ROC AUC metrics
process_cluster_predictions: process cluster predictions by loading outputs, computing individual and ensemble accuracy metrics
compute_ensemble_weights: compute softmax ensemble weights based on task embedding distances to cluster centers
generate_results_csv: generate a CSV report with per-dataset and average ensemble evaluation results
